GPT-OSS-20B Benchmark Rollouts (512 tokens)
	

This dataset contains text generation outputs from OpenAI's GPT-OSS-20B model across multiple evaluation benchmarks, with generation limited to 512 tokens.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

The dataset captures GPT-OSS-20B's text generation behavior when responding to prompts from established AI evaluation benchmarks. Each example includes the original prompt, the model's generated response, and token statistics.
